item.description:
CFTC adopts reporting rules for certain event contracts

The final rule covers certain fully collateralized contracts. Market and trade data requirements start 60 days after Federal Register publication. Large-trader reporting starts no earlier than July 26, 2027. Exchanges have 12 months from publication to collect trader details, including occupation and employer.

item.title: CFTC staff outlines how crypto can count toward operating reserves Staff says de
item.description:
CFTC staff outlines how crypto can count toward operating reserves

Staff says derivatives venues and clearinghouses can count BTC, ETH and payment stablecoins toward resources for 12 months of operating costs. Haircut benchmarks are at least 20% for BTC and ETH and 2% for payment stablecoins.

The advisory leaves the separate cash and liquid securities requirement in place.

https://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/9331-26

item.title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Nvidia says its board voted unanimou
item.description:
Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO

Nvidia says its board voted unanimously to bring founder Jensen Huang back as president, CEO and a board director. The company disclosed in a Form 8-K that the decision took effect on November 22. It announced the move on November 23.

Colette Kress remains CFO and Harvey Jones remains board chair. Nvidia says its independent board investigation will continue.

https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-board-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-president-ceo-and-board-director

CoinDesk reported that more than $1.5B in USDC left Sky’s Peg Stability Module on November 19. In its snapshot, USDS market cap was about $3.2B, down more than 30%, while the price held near $1.

item.title: VanEck to end Gemini agreements for three crypto ETFs VanEck gave Gemini notice
item.description:
VanEck to end Gemini agreements for three crypto ETFs

VanEck gave Gemini notice that it will end custody and clearing agreements for its Bitcoin (HODL), Ethereum (ETHV) and Solana (VSOL) ETFs. The filings give February 16, 2027 for VSOL and on or about that date for HODL and ETHV.

Coinbase Custody will continue as a custodian for all three. Gemini’s SOL staking arrangement for VSOL also ends.

https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2028541/000202854126000014/vsol-20261116.htm

item.description:

The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.25% on November 19. AMD led the declines among the seven public-market names tied to Anthropic’s private placement, falling 7.72%. Alphabet fell 3.46%, and Nvidia lost 3.30%.

Anthropic closed at $97.17, down 12.85% from its opening trade but up 17.07% from its $83 IPO price.
